summary: flatten parameters: required list, levels to limit recursion depth, and skip_nulls (default true) to drop null elements.
questions: How do I flatten only one level of a nested list?

answer_card.title: flatten parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (list, required)
- `levels` (int): how many levels deep to flatten
- `skip_nulls` (default **true**): skip `null`/`None` elements
